$comment: Authoritative map for the 40-row README feature wall: all 27 core crash-course lessons, three distinct workflow-use paths, and Extras A.1 through A.10. validate.mjs checks README.md, capture sources, assets/feature-wall/, and .gitattributes against this file.

course.name: Atomic crash course
course.seed_policy: Read-only. Every capture clones the seed into its own throwaway HOME; the seed itself is never written to.

capture.control_path: VHS drives a real terminal running the installed atomic binary. Keystrokes are real keystrokes; every frame is real product output.
capture.home_policy: Each lesson records in $FW_BUILD/capture-homes/<id>, a throwaway HOME seeded with only auth.json, models-store.json, and settings.json. No unrelated session, skill, prompt, or personal resource is mounted.
capture.credential_policy: auth.json is copied with cp and is never read, parsed, printed, or echoed by any script here.

render.encoder_note: gifski encodes every shipped GIF from real capture frames. ffmpeg only trims, masks, adjusts pace, and downscales.
render.encoded_fps_note: Three checks cover separate failure modes. min_distinct_frames counts rendered states, while min_encoded_fps rejects clips with too little motion overall. max_frame_hold_s also caps any one decoded state, so a burst of late motion cannot hide a padded still. Contact-sheet review warns at review_hold_warning_s because shorter holds can still hide irrelevant content and need human review.
render.grid_fps_note: One centisecond. GIF delays are integers in centiseconds, so 1/12s = 8.333cs is unrepresentable and a true 12 fps GIF alternates 8cs and 9cs delays. The tolerance is the format precision limit, not slack.

privacy.scope: Narrowed by the repository owner: their own name, personal file names, unrelated session or workflow-run names, and ordinary local paths are acceptable on screen. A credential and the operator's provider/model label are not.
privacy.mask: A structural frame pass locates and paints the dynamic statusline band, where the provider and model render. A second OCR pass paints provider/model text elsewhere, matching by reconstructed line and by adjacent line pairs so a terminal wrap cannot hide a label.
privacy.mask_rationale: Provider/model fields move between terminal layouts and workflow views. Structural masking removes the persistent band without depending on OCR; the text pass covers transient banners and panels. Both paint existing fields with the terminal background and never add or relabel UI.
privacy.shell_prompt: PS1 is set to a bare '$ ' with HISTFILE=/dev/null, so no personal shell history is ever on screen.
privacy.wrap_note: Rules are matched against the OCR text and against the same text with whitespace removed. A hard terminal wrap once split openai-codex across two lines and passed a green gate.
